transcript.label: Transcript:

reactions.notConnected: WhatsApp is not connected. You can react when it is back.

notes.placeholder: Add a note for your team

reconnect.title: Reconnecting to server…
reconnect.body: New messages and updates may be delayed until the connection is back.

connecting.title: Connecting to WhatsApp…
connecting.body: Messages you send will go out when the connection is back.

disconnected.title: WhatsApp is disconnected
disconnected.body: Reconnecting automatically. Messages will send when reconnected.

qr.title: WhatsApp is not linked
qr.body: An admin needs to scan the QR code to link the team number.

loggedOut.title: WhatsApp was logged out
loggedOut.body: An admin must re-link the number before messages can be sent.

replaced.title: WhatsApp opened in another session
replaced.body: This app was disconnected because the number was used elsewhere. An admin can take over.

blocked.title: WhatsApp connection blocked
blocked.body: The connection was refused. An admin should check the WhatsApp page.

phoneLink.label: WhatsApp number (with country code)
phoneLink.enterCode: Enter this code on your phone
phoneLink.step1: Open WhatsApp on the phone with this number.
phoneLink.step2: Go to Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
phoneLink.step3: Tap Link with phone number instead and enter the code.

push.unsupported: Notifications aren't supported in this browser.
push.label: Notifications
push.desktopHint: Alerts appear when this app is in the background. Keep it running in the tray and allow EzyChat Lite in your system notification settings.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the browser's site settings.

errors.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
errors.serviceWorker: Service worker is not active yet. Reload the page and try again.
errors.noKey: Server did not return a push key
errors.desktopUnavailable: Desktop notifications are unavailable. Check your operating system notification settings.

installHint.title: Add to Home Screen to receive notifications
installHint.body: Tap the Share button in Safari, choose Add to Home Screen, then open EzyChat Lite from your home screen and turn on notifications.

mockWindow.marketingNote: Marketing templates may go only to customers who agreed to receive them.
